take: ideaForge exhibits severe operational lumpiness driven by concentrated defense orders, leading to highly volatile quarterly revenue and cash flows. The company suffers from a severely inflated working capital cycle of 587 days, consuming cash despite long-term market opportunities.

promises.promise: Complete delivery of remaining order book of INR256.8 crores by Q3.
Blended EBITDA margin expectation for the year is 50% to 55%
Deliver 40% to 45% of open order book in Q4 FY26.
promises.delivered: Executed around 40% of open order book, recording INR141.04 crores revenue in Q4.

promises.promise: Confident in full year's gross margin trajectory of 50% plus for FY26.
promises.delivered: Annual OPM for FY26 was 2.6% with PAT at negative INR17 crores.

narrative.claim: Management states that order booking momentum converts into execution, closing FY26 with positive EBITDA.
narrative.numbers: Annual operating margin for FY26 was 2.6% and net profit was negative INR17 crores.

narrative.claim: Management highlights expanding international presence and US joint venture scale-up.
narrative.numbers: Revenue remains primarily domestic with 5-year CAGR at 45.2% but annual revenue dropped from INR314 crores in FY24 to INR226 crores in FY26.

narrative.claim: Management points to strong demand environment and major order intake.
narrative.numbers: Opening order book for FY27 stands at approximately INR3,140 millions.

guidance.latest: Complete delivery of remaining INR256.8 crores order book by Q3

bull.point: Dominant market position in Indian defense and security drone procurement with over 1,000,000 cumulative flights globally.
Large opening order book of approximately INR3,140 millions provides medium-term revenue visibility for FY27.
Extensive R&D focus with a 300+ member team across four product development centers supporting combat and logistics UAVs.

bear.point: Working capital cycle has worsened significantly, reaching 587 days as of March 2026.
Heavy negative cash flow from operations, turning negative 119% of 5-year profit into operating cash.
Severe revenue and profit lumpiness with negative annual net profit of INR17 crores in FY26.

watch: Execution of the remaining INR256.8 crores order book by Q3 FY27.
Cash conversion cycle and debtor days trajectory.
US operations and Blue sUAS certification progress.
